name: web-glowing-particle-envelope-icons-network-dark-blue
title: Glowing particle-built envelope icons connected by thin data-network lines on deep blue

whatItMeans: Abstract and technical; particle-built icons feel more like data science than a literal photo, fitting automation and analytics themes.
techniques: Build an icon from a grid of glowing particles instead of a solid shape.
Connect multiple icons with thin network lines for a systemic feel.
Keep the palette to one glowing colour on near-black for focus.
